column3: With respect to the Bender Square Mortgage Loan (1.0%), the related Mortgaged Property was impacted by a documented release of hazardous substances resulting from historical dry-cleaning operations conducted at a south adjoining property, which the related ESA identified as a REC. The related ESA recommended continued following of the active “Dry Cleaner Remediation Program” case at the south adjoining property to assure that the responsible party is continuing to comply with Texas Commission on Environmental Quality “Dry Cleaner Remediation Program” regulations so that future closure is obtained that incorporates the impacted area of the related Mortgaged Property.
